_comment: H3-DDG on BindingGYM, inter-assay split. Hyperparameters follow the paper's Appendix A.4 (NOT config/train_h3-ddg.json, which is the SKEMPI setting).
_comment_hyperedges: Appendix A.4 says hyperedges were selected from {L/10, L/6, L/4} and 4-body edges from {1N, 2N, 3N} but does not state which was used for BindingGYM. We take L/4 + 3N, the combination Appendix B.5 reports as best.
_comment_eval: eval_batch_size > 1 is safe here because train_bindinggym.py aligns predictions to metadata via complex_row_indices(); monitor_per_assay caps the in-training monitoring eval, the end-of-run eval is always full.
_comment_ckpt: ckpt_freq: save a resume point every N iterations. Sparse on purpose -- 3 saves over 20,000 iterations is enough to make a walltime kill cost one interval instead of the whole run.
